subject: Learning Methods
title: Training Attention Like a Muscle
description: A 60-second lesson on Training Attention Like a Muscle.

hook.text: Monks who meditate for years show dramatically thicker attention-related brain regions on MRI scans.

buildup.text: Attention is trainable. Meditation, specifically focused-attention meditation, strengthens the networks you need.

discovery.text: Just ten minutes daily for eight weeks measurably improves sustained attention in controlled studies.

twist.text: You don't need a meditation app. Simply focusing on your breath and noticing when your mind wanders is the exercise.

climax.text: The moment you catch your mind wandering is the rep. That noticing and redirecting is exactly what strengthens.

punchline.text: Catching the wandering mind is the workout. Every rep counts.

quiz.question: What is the 'exercise' in attention meditation training?
options: Clearing the mind of all thoughts
Noticing when the mind wanders and redirecting focus
